title: 25 Years After 9/11: Lessons for Securing the Homeland
summary_en: Reflecting on 25 years since the September 11 terror attacks, RAND experts answer questions about protecting soft targets, the role of the TSA, mitigating risks from emerging technologies, and more.
title_cn: 25 Years After 9/11: Lessons for Securing the Homeland

title: Novel technologies for security-sector governance and management
summary_en: RAND Europe scoped technology use in security-sector governance and management, mapping opportunities and risks from real-world cases and distilling lessons and good practices to embed good governance in the adoption and use of these tools.
title_cn: Novel technologies for security-sector governance and management
